scenarios.sos_intent: I am homeless or have nowhere safe to sleep tonight
essential_questions: Are you or anyone with you in immediate physical danger?
Do you have dependent children or vulnerable individuals with you?
Are you street homeless right now?

service.name: Birmingham City Council Housing Solutions / Homelessness Team
service.eligibility_notes: Applies if eligible and homeless or threatened with homelessness within 56 days. Automatic priority need applies if children or vulnerabilities are present.
service.contact_route: Emergency out-of-hours phone line or local housing hub

scenarios.fallback_service: Contact the Shelter Emergency Helpline for free expert housing and legal rights advice.
scenarios.escalation: If temporary emergency accommodation is refused and children are at risk, Children's Services safeguarding or local emergency support routes can be activated.

scenarios.sos_intent: I have no food and cannot afford to buy groceries
essential_questions: Do you have any means of preparing or cooking food?
Are there infants or young children needing emergency food or formula?

service.name: Birmingham Crisis and Resilience Fund & Local Food Banks
service.eligibility_notes: Aimed at Birmingham residents facing severe financial hardship or emergency destitution.
service.contact_route: Apply via Birmingham City Council welfare assistance or local food bank referral networks.

scenarios.fallback_service: Contact Citizens Advice Birmingham or local community mutual aid groups for emergency food parcels.
scenarios.escalation: If acute medical distress or severe starvation occurs, contact NHS 111 or emergency services.
